deviations.why: Explore track: free choice; took the flagship row 5 (photo-editing) BUILDABLE item instead of allocate's pick (einvoice-preflight), because C-RAW was a well-defined decoder with a perfect oracle (LibRaw) and three real files at hand
deviations.did: C-RAW decoder, Python + C, checked sensel-for-sensel
deviations.result: 0 of 76.7 M sensels differ on three real files

notes: Idea: Canon CR3 C-RAW (CMP1 0x200, 3-level 5/3 wavelet, QP-grid quantisation) decoded independently from the format as LibRaw crx.cpp reads it (no code copied). Every sensel equal to LibRaw 0.22 on IMG_0041, _MG_0045 (EOS R8) and the EOS R3 file from metadata-extractor-images, both engines; C 0.57-0.74 s, Python 25-28 s per file. R3 half-size develop: median 0.24 8-bit step vs LibRaw. Local checks: run_venture_tests.py photo-editing ok (0 failed, 67 s); tests/test_cr3_wavelet.py 13 tests, four hand mutations each fail 1-18 tests. Decoding each subband whole and inverting per level (instead of LibRaw's streaming state machine) matched on the first full run.
